profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Jordan has an Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of Utah. In this program he has learned various coding languages such as C, Java, Python, C#, x86 Assembly, and JavaScript. Jordan implemented various data structures such hash-sets, trees, maps, and linked lists. He has also designed and coded a compiler, a web browser, and a new FFMPEG audio encoder.

positions.title: Permit and Plans Specialist
positions.description:
- Designed basement remodel floor plans that meet city and state requirements.
- Responsible for application revisions, applied for basement permits, and ensured permits were accessible to project managers.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Coded and executed automated tests for the CRM application.
- Identified and repaired failing automated tests.
- Performed story estimations and completed development work for each story.
- Performed peer code reviews and validated software functionality in dev environment.
